title: Co-founder & CEO (Imperial Robot Learning Lab director)
segment: Robot foundation model trained entirely in simulation ('Instant Robot Learning' from one demonstration); Imperial College spinout
top_signal: Came out of stealth with a $40M seed co-led by Creandum and Union Square Ventures (largest UK robotics seed); money goes to scaling the model and a new King's Cross office and lab
why_now: London-based, so Raion's UK capacity is local. Its model is trained only in simulation, which is GPU-intensive, and the round's stated purpose is scaling that model. An 11-person, founder-led team that can sign fast. Below the $50M size bar, so start with a part-block or one block.
